RESULT [webresearch]: BrowseComp rises from 51.4 without context management to 67.6 with discard-all; the Summary strategy extends runs to an average of 364 steps. Other reported scores: GPT-5 54.9, Claude Sonnet 4.5 24.1, Kimi-K2-Thinking 60.2. HLE text with search: 40.8, vs GPT-5 35.2 and Gemini-3.0-Pro 45.8.
US [webresearch]: Adopt the context-management trick. Our brains are open models with limited context, and long literature or harvest sessions overflow it. Reported gains of about 16 points come from harness design alone, with no change to the model.
